scope: Run Rand Waltzman's bio-surveillance coordination scenario (From Minds to Coordination) through the any-scenario pipeline and report, with evidence, which of its mechanisms the generated world represents and which it misses.

fact_evidence.existing_implementation_obstacle: Uses the existing any-scenario pipeline (spikes/any-scenario-2026-10) unchanged except fixes the run itself shows are needed.
fact_evidence.reproduced_failure: New capability proof, not a repair.
fact_evidence.concurrent_writers: check_coordination_claims.py --check --project world-substrate returned 'No active claims' on 2026-10-08.
fact_evidence.machine_consumed_planning_handoff: One writer runs all increments in sequence; no planning handoff to another agent.
fact_evidence.shared_contract_mutation: No shared contract change planned; a run, an evidence folder and a written assessment.
fact_evidence.persistent_migration: No stored data or schema migration.
fact_evidence.consequential_external_mutation: No deploy, publication or outreach; live /waltzman/ and World Builder sites are out of scope.
fact_evidence.answer_only: Brian asked for the next /goal on 2026-10-08 ('give me the new /goal text') after the recommendation to run Waltzman's scenario.
fact_evidence.continuity_beyond_session: Delivered as a /goal; a few hours of agent work.
fact_evidence.one_writer: Single implementation agent; research subagents are read-only.
fact_evidence.reversible: Branch work merged through pull requests; spike folder and tested Engine changes revert with git.
fact_evidence.boundary_known: world-substrate only; cybernetic_influence_v3 read-only (source of the scenario description); no deploy, no outreach.

rationale: One writer, reversible, single repository, no shared contract change; continuity carried by the goal.
